description: Guarantee a pointer drag ends even when the release event never arrives. Use when a dragged element sticks to the cursor after the mouse button is let go, when a drag keeps following an unpressed pointer after the cursor re-enters the page, when the user releases outside the window or over another application, or when building any drag interaction on a canvas, slider, divider, resizer, knob, or map. `setPointerCapture` alone does not fix this.
